{{Quote|&hellip;you shoulda' seen the results of our tests on Fest&mdash;my weapons are gonna put a lot of holes in a lot of Rebel scum&mdash;.|[[Rebus (Galactic Empire)|Moff Rebus]]|<ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>}}
The '''assault cannon''' was a weapon with two firing modes used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II dark troopers]]. Each assault cannon fired [[plasma shell]]s as their primary ammunition, and the weapon could also launch long-range [[Missile/Legends|explosive rockets]].<ref name="EGTD" />

Though the weapon was exclusively designed for the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark trooper]] [[battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], an ordinary [[humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] could use it. [[Kyle Katarn]] was able to acquire such a weapon during the campaign to eliminate the [[Dark Trooper Project]].<ref name="DF" />
